scope: Single archived cut, one compute thread per process. Complete native hierarchy, matching and symmetry finalization. No decoding or verification. Both policies use the same bounded complete-fragment cache. Peak RSS is cumulative process residency measured before saving each graph. Repeated-run peak can include earlier serialization. Equality checks include complete ordered compressed records, not expanded atom bijections.

validation.small_cache_tests: Exact results under forced eviction and oversized-entry rejection; changed cuts, mappings, islands, occupancy and boundaries; RAM/bundle local work-pool stage parity.

measurement_conditions: One fresh single-thread process per policy, overlapping on separate cores of the M4 Pro; full test suite also ran during part of the first searches. CPU times are reported; one cold observation per policy. Serialization is outside matching timing. No cluster jobs or cache limits changed.

paired_check.scope: Same process and thread, independent prepared sessions; alternating warmed policy order. CPU time includes full cut search/export and finalization. Equality checks are outside timing.
paired_check.analysis: All samples retained. Each AB/BA order receives equal weight to control the observed second-operation cost; there are eight incremental-first and seven existence-first samples.
